title: Prospective Open-Event-Universe Causal Cone Constitution, Outcome-Blind Lineage Quotients, Well-Founded Closure-or-Divergence Certificates, Quotient-Collision Falsification, Abstraction-Preserving Necessity/Sufficiency & Exact-Event Explanation Drill-Down

parent_authority.inherited_boundary: Exact-address closure succeeded for Stockfish but the two Ethereal witnesses continued generating novel exact events through the frozen P33 refinement cap.

objective: Test whether an outcome-blind finite quotient of TT semantic-use events can close the intervention universe while preserving root-move causal authority and exact-event drill-down, or else certify failure of the entire frozen quotient lattice without post-hoc feature invention.

quotient_lattice.selection_rule: Start at Q0 and refine monotonically only when a prospectively named gate fails. The first level passing every closure, causal, collision and drill-down gate is the selected quotient. No new coordinate may be added after P34 outcomes.
quotient_lattice.finite_domain_nonclaim: Finite coding makes each Q-level finite, but finite representational range alone is not evidence that the quotient is causally adequate.
quotient_lattice.order_theory_nonclaim: Q0→Q3 is a prospectively frozen monotone refinement chain over event-role coordinates. It is not claimed to be a Madaleno-style coarsening lattice of a known ground-truth causal DAG; the order-theoretic role is experimental search discipline only.

intervention_semantics.parent_condition: The P33 baseline-seed exact-address removal is always active. P34 cone interventions are additional dynamic predicates evaluated at each TT semantic-use event during the measurement search.
intervention_semantics.dynamic_remove: REMOVE_CONE_SET blocks every event at the frozen frontier whose quotient tuple belongs to the selected cone set, including exact events not present in the parent trace.
intervention_semantics.dynamic_keep: KEEP_CONE_SET blocks every non-seed event at the frozen frontier whose quotient tuple is not in the retained cone set. Previously unseen quotient classes are therefore blocked rather than silently escaping.
intervention_semantics.remove_all: REMOVE_ALL_CONES blocks all non-seed family events at the frozen frontier.
intervention_semantics.storage_boundary: No TT storage, indexing, replacement, age, key generation, or native value production is edited.

closure_or_divergence.refinement_rule: For every quotient-intervention replay path actually visited by REMOVE_SET, KEEP_SET, REMOVE_ALL, ddmin, or leave-one-out, every newly observed quotient class is appended without ranking and the level court restarts. A fixed point requires no new quotient class on all such visited quotient-intervention paths under the frozen caps. Exact-address drill-down is a downstream falsification test and does not reopen the quotient universe; any mismatch is retained as failed query commutation.
closure_or_divergence.level_pass: A level passes representation closure only at a replay-discovered fixed point under the frozen caps.
closure_or_divergence.divergence_certificate: If Q0,Q1,Q2,Q3 all fail prospectively named closure/collision/causal-preservation gates, emit BOUNDED_QUOTIENT_LATTICE_DIVERGENCE. This is a certificate against the frozen lattice, not a proof that no possible abstraction exists.

causal_gates.conditional_necessity: Conditioned on P33 seed removal, removing a quotient set must change the root move relative to the seed-only parent.
causal_gates.retaining_sufficiency: Conditioned on P33 seed removal, retaining only a quotient subset must restore the seed-only parent root move.
causal_gates.minimality: Final sets must be inclusion-1-minimal by exact leave-one-out within the replay-discovered closed quotient universe.
causal_gates.positive_control: The Stockfish P33 positive-control case must not lose its already established conditional causal structure under the selected quotient.

collision_falsification.member_source: Exact P32 addresses observed in the seed-only parent trace and mapped to each selected quotient class.
collision_falsification.singleton_probe: For every quotient class participating in either the inclusion-minimal removal set or the inclusion-minimal retaining set, if it has at most 12 parent-trace exact members, replay seed removal plus each exact member separately and record the root semantic response signature.
collision_falsification.collision_predicate: Two parent-trace exact members in the same quotient class with different singleton root bestmoves constitute a quotient collision under the frozen probe.
collision_falsification.large_class_rule: A selected cone with more than 12 observed exact members is DRILLDOWN_SIZE_HOLD rather than collision-free by sampling.
collision_falsification.remove_exact_expansion_probe: Replay seed removal plus the union of all parent-trace exact members of the minimal REMOVE quotient set and compare its root bestmove with dynamic REMOVE_SET. Equality is REMOVE_LOCAL_EXACT_EXPANSION_PARITY.
collision_falsification.keep_exact_expansion_probe: Replay seed removal plus every parent-trace exact member whose quotient class is outside the minimal KEEP set and compare its root bestmove with dynamic KEEP_SET. Equality is KEEP_LOCAL_EXACT_EXPANSION_PARITY.
collision_falsification.query_commutation_gate: A quotient level may pass only when both REMOVE and KEEP local exact-expansion parities hold, no selected causal cone has a forbidden singleton-response collision, and no selected causal cone exceeds the frozen exact-member drill-down cap.

implementation_roles.C_or_Cpp: Engine-native dynamic quotient predicate and trace emission layered over the P32 exact seed-removal hook.
implementation_roles.Rust: Independent quotient compiler/verifier and LawGen v10 constitution.
implementation_roles.Python: UCI orchestration, prospective quotient-lattice court, exact-event drill-down, PV legality and move grounding.

external_code_study.lesson: Full-key verification, depth/bound semantics and replacement age make raw TT entries stateful; P34 therefore does not equate table slot identity with causal event identity.
tt_probe/tt_store expose hash, height, move, value/eval, depth and bound as distinct native coordinates; P34 keeps intervention at semantic-use sites rather than altering table mechanics.
TTProbe exposes ply, score/eval/depth/bound/PV channels separately; supports keeping semantic-role coordinates explicit rather than collapsing all TT hits.
DAG/tree-search implementations reinforce separating node reuse/topology from behavioral output; P34 treats a quotient as an abstraction to falsify, not as node identity.
Testing infrastructure separates experiment contract from result adjudication; P34 freezes quotient lattice and gates before selective execution.
Deterministic engine protocol/opening handling is treated as infrastructure, not causal evidence.
Used only for legal PV and chess-atom verification; legality is independent of causal authority.

data_policy.reason: P34 tests representation closure on the exact three inherited P33 causal worlds; adding PGN positions would change the estimand rather than solve the identified open-event-universe problem.
data_policy.future_rule: PGN or additional GitHub-derived world corpora may be introduced only in a later fresh transport/replication stage after P34 establishes or rejects the quotient representation.

claim_ceiling: A P34 quotient is an operational event-role abstraction, not metaphysical event identity.
The frozen Q0→Q3 lattice is intentionally low-capacity; failure does not imply that no causal abstraction exists.
Replay-discovered fixed points cover only paths visited by the frozen court.
Conditional necessity/sufficiency remain relative to the P33 baseline-seed removal intervention.
Singleton collision probes concern parent-trace exact members and do not establish global within-class interchangeability.
Bidirectional local query-commutation parity is a bounded REMOVE/KEEP drill-down test on parent-trace exact members, not proof of full low/high-level causal equivalence.
No chess strategy, cognition, intent, prevalence or cross-position generalization is authorized.
